description: Intuitive way to track progress against a target value for multiple categories with our modern Activity Gauge by Powerviz. Activity Gauge is a Powerful visual representation and indicator to show the level of activity or metric by category. It is typically presented in the form of a gauge or circular shape, displaying a range of values or percentages. The activity gauge is designed to quickly convey the current status or progress of the activity, allowing users to assess and understand the data at a glance. It is commonly used in for project management, performance tracking, and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs). Check out the live demo here. To access all pro features, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner of the visual. Key Feature Highlights: Gauge customization – Full Control over the gauge shape and remaining gauge style. Add icons inside the arc, and more formatting options to create personalized design. Target - Choose a target from the dropdown or set a custom target using a field. Color Scheme – Offers 30+ color palettes including color-blind safe mode for better accessibility. Labels – Add data labels and leaf labels that improve readability, and can be placed inside and outside the shape. Centre Circle – Design the center circle with multiple layer options.
